skeleton.core_finance_question: After reconciling the reported definition and period basis, determine which of US_TREASURY_30Y_CMT's treasury_yield_30y changes was higher: as of 2001-01-10–as of 2001-01-11 or as of 2001-01-11–as of 2001-01-12.

After resolving ambiguous peer matches, compare Mexico's exports_goods_services_current_usd growth from year ended 2006-12-31 to year ended 2007-12-31 with the mean growth for China and Italy, then cross-check the result.

When the initial result mismatches one required field, refine the query to recover all three US_FED_FUNDS_MARKET federal_funds_rate observations and compare growth in as of 1972-08-14–as of 1972-08-15 with as of 1972-08-15–as of 1972-08-16.
